Experience in fast-paced and dynamic product development environments.

This role sits within our Digital Enterprise Technology organization, driving automated build, test, and deployment processes with a security and trust mindset.
You will act as a trusted advisor and advocate for internal customers, developing innovative solutions to solve complex engineering challenges.
Core Responsibilities & Scope
Create, improve, and support CI/CD pipelines and other developer tools.
Build effective guardrails around software development and release processes to ensure high quality and security.
Advocate for internal customers by consulting on their technical requirements and building innovative solutions to meet their needs.
Maintain a security and trust mindset when designing, implementing, and supporting engineering systems.
Integrate agentic capabilities into our tools to leverage cutting edge technology and continuously improve the developer experience.
Minimum Requirements
3+ years of experience in a Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or similar technical role.
In-depth knowledge of source control systems, software branching strategies, trunk-based development, and CI frameworks such as GitHub Actions.
Proven experience creating build, test, and deployment pipelines, as well as proficiency in scripting or object-oriented programming.
Hands-on experience working in a Test-Driven Development (TDD) environment with a focus on quality and software design.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation, and automation tools such as Chef, Puppet, or Ansible.
Experience working with public cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure, along with container technology like Docker.
Strong understanding of cloud-native microservice architecture and secure software development lifecycle practices.
Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams in an Agile software development environment.
